title: §81 The word-matching allocation-cost case did not travel upstream with the matcher work
body:
**Preserved** ℹ: at submodule commit `eb0ac0ff2`, reachable in the submodule's history; restore locally with
`git -C app/src/main/cpp/libosmscout checkout eb0ac0ff2 -- the test file`.
The fix lands in the submodule — a focused upstream PR on top of upstream's copy, followed by the gitlink bump.

title: §24 The sharp-s uppercase form is not folded
body:
**Known limitation** ℹ: the character map row for U+1E9E folds to itself, and the table it sits in is regenerated
from upstream's own source.
The fix lands in the submodule, where that table is generated rather than in a commit this run can make.

title: §73 The phone overlay keeps the old bearing after a long press
§82 The kept worktree is reported clean while the submodule it holds is dirty
body:
**Observed** ✗: the reset reports a clean tree while `app/src/main/cpp/libosmscout` carries a modified file — the
dirt was seen on the submodule's `stylesheets/standard.oss`, and the next start refuses the tree.
**Where the fix lands** ⊨: `tools/loop/worktree.sh`'s reset path, which never asks the submodule for its status.

title: §83 The pre-screen report quotes a phrase the queue never reads
body:
`The fix lands in the submodule` is the phrase this item quotes to show what the marker looks like; the fix it
owes is in `tools/loop/report.sh`'s own line, and nothing here has to be committed anywhere else.
